baseline.conditions: Winter closure possible; ridge wayhouses and slower ascent.

title: Warmth has an address
daily_life: Stonewake crews trade with Hushvale guides and archive workers. A warm refuge is maintained, occupied and finite, not a reward placed at the end of every chase.
timing: Fifteen days covers slower ascent and ridge wayhouses. Winter may close the route entirely. The two-day safe detour around the Cut Span is a separate local itinerary, not automatically included in these fifteen days.
handoff: Send departure information before leaving and confirm the next refuge. A late report triggers a bounded search plan; silence alone cannot locate a party.
story_option: A familiar voice from the ice offers a shortcut. A visual check and a known warm place are more valuable than a persuasive imitation.
production: Snow, wet clothing and tool ice persist across cuts. Echo ice and choirwraith mimicry are different mechanisms, neither a resurrection or complete witness.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
